title: ONE READABLE TARGET PING LABEL
why: The solo ping critic still found the normal enemy name touching the ping label. A live target ping now carries the specific enemy identity and distance in one existing readable plate; its old name text and backing wait until that ping expires. Crew and wounded-health marks stay visible, and the peddler keeps its deal prompt. Both maps use 24px target glyphs with 28px dark backing at 1080p. Sound, input, lifetime, sharing and world generation are unchanged. Playtest watch: mark a wounded sentry in solo and in either party window, check that one name and its health pip remain, then wait 10 seconds for the usual name to return; check both maps near white walls.
now: Target pings use one readable name label and larger map markers.
